before.RouteNotes: CB: route guessed from endpoints — Strong direct hit: Egypt Oil & Gas's feature 'Egypt's Gas Distribution Network, An Intricate Economic Web' explicitly names 'Damanhur-Tanta' as one of Egypt's 10 main Nile Delta gas transmission lines (capacity 700.1 mmcf/d, the largest of the group listed), confirming this is a real, named, standalone trunk line, not merely a sheet hypothesis (sheet StartLocation/EndLocation were blank; PipelineName already said Damanhur-Tanta). Great-circle distance between the two town centers is ~58km, closely matching the sheet's 60km length -- a very good fit for a direct point-to-point line. On the hint (GulfPub 'Idku-Tanta Pipeline', 108km): the same Egypt Oil & Gas article lists 'Alexandria Network-Damanhur' and 'Damanhur-Tanta' as TWO SEPARATE named segments, more consistent with P8019 being its own discrete Damanhur-Tanta trunk within the broader delta grid (with gas reaching Tanta via Damanhur from multiple upstream directions, Idku included) than a literal 'Damanhur-Tanta portion' carved out of one distinct 108km GulfPub-only 'Idku-Tanta' line. No independent public source was found naming a 108km 'Idku-Tanta' line by that exact name, so the GulfPub product itself is neither confirmed nor refuted here -- but the Damanhur-Tanta segment is independently well-attested regardless. Facility-level (compressor/valve site) coordinates were not found in public sources; both endpoints are town-center approximations, standard for a rung-4 (endpoints/great-circle) candidate. Start coord basis: Wikipedia 'Damanhur' infobox town-center coordinate (verified live fetch: 31.04056N 30.47000E).. End coord basis: Wikipedia 'Tanta' infobox town-center coordinate (verified live fetch: 30.783N 31.000E)..

before.RouteNotes: CB: route guessed from endpoints — Route and existence are corroborated by TWO independent Egypt Oil & Gas sources: the Feb-2020 industry-guide pipeline table gives 'Talkha-Tanta-Cairo': From=Talkha Distribution Station, To=Cairo, Length=125 km, Diameter=28 in — the length matches GEM's sheet value (125 km) EXACTLY, strong corroboration of the route as named. A separate 2016 Egypt Oil & Gas feature independently lists 'Talkha-Tanta-Cairo' among the Nile Delta's main trunk pipelines and states it carries gas 'to feed electric stations with natural gas in Cairo.' Tanta (Wikipedia coords 30.783N, 31.000E) is confirmed as a real intermediate city on this trunk's name and geographic path (roughly on the straight line between Talkha and Cairo) but is a WAYPOINT, not one of the two route-candidate endpoints requested by this task's schema — flagging it here so a human building the actual geometry knows the corridor should bend through/near Tanta rather than run as a single straight Talkha-Cairo chord. Both endpoint coordinates are city-level anchors (not specific named take-off/injection stations), so RouteAccuracy should be capped at 'low' per the standard great-circle-endpoints rung even though resolved:true. Start coord basis: Coordinates for the Talkha CCGT power plant / industrial hub (Global Energy Observatory) used as a proxy anchor for 'Talkha Distribution Station', the named origin in the Egypt Oil & Gas pipeline table; corroborated at city level by Wikipedia's Talkha coordinates (31.0547N, 31.3756E, ~2 km away). End coord basis: Wikipedia infobox coordinates for Cairo (city-center anchor, coarse — not a specific facility).
